title.en: Look up a domain's MX records

why.en: Before relaying, a mail server asks DNS where the recipient domain's mail goes. You can do the same lookup.
why.hinglish: Relay se pehle mail server DNS se poochta hai ki recipient domain ka mail kahan jayega. Wahi lookup aap bhi kar sakte ho.

expect.en: A list of lines like '5 gmail-smtp-in.l.google.com' with a preference number and a host. The exact hosts and numbers can change; the lowest number is tried first.
expect.hinglish: '5 gmail-smtp-in.l.google.com' jaisi lines ki list, preference number aur host ke saath. Exact hosts aur numbers badal sakte hain; sabse chhota number pehle try hota hai.

title.en: Test if the submission port is open
title.hinglish: Submission port khula hai ya nahi test karo

why.en: Port 587 is where mail apps submit mail. This only opens a TCP connection and does not send any email.
why.hinglish: Port 587 wo hai jahan mail apps mail submit karti hain. Ye sirf TCP connection kholta hai, koi email nahi bhejta.

expect.en: TcpTestSucceeded : True (or 'succeeded'). Some home or office networks block outgoing SMTP ports, so it may fail on yours.
expect.hinglish: TcpTestSucceeded : True (ya 'succeeded'). Kuch home ya office networks outgoing SMTP ports block karte hain, isliye aapke network par fail ho sakta hai.

title.en: Read the SMTP commands in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark to see EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA and the 3-digit replies.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA aur 3-digit replies dekho.

expect.en: A list of command and reply lines. Right-click one and choose Follow > TCP Stream to read the whole conversation, including the 550 in the bounce scenario.
expect.hinglish: Command aur reply lines ki list. Kisi par right-click karke Follow > TCP Stream chuno aur poori baatcheet padho, bounce scenario ka 550 bhi.

why.en: After STARTTLS the same connection turns into a TLS handshake. Filter to see where plain SMTP stops.
why.hinglish: STARTTLS ke baad wahi connection TLS handshake ban jaata hai. Filter lagao aur dekho plain SMTP kahan rukta hai.

expect.en: The STARTTLS command, then TLS Client Hello and Server Hello, after which the data is unreadable.
expect.hinglish: STARTTLS command, phir TLS Client Hello aur Server Hello, jiske baad data padha nahi ja sakta.
